basic_profile.bio: I'm a 16-year-old high school student from California. I enjoy exploring different cultures and international politics, which is why I frequently visit subreddits like unitedstatesofindia and Israel. My interests also include music, especially artists like Kygo, and I sometimes check out subreddits like StefJuicy for fun. I occasionally visit humorous and edgy subreddits like GayCumTribute for laughs. I’m online mostly in the evenings after school and on weekends. Currently single, I spend my free time playing video games and hanging out with friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a keen interest in global politics, fueled by my social studies classes at school and online research. I also follow music trends closely and enjoy learning about different music production techniques through online forums and YouTube tutorials.
